{{Top|leg}}
'''The Ghost Ones''' was the name given to the mysterious and nomadic clan of [[Senali]] that lived without family ties. Considered troublemakers by the other Senali, they were known for creating rivalries between other clans over trivial matters. The Ghost Ones spoke out against the custom of [[Rutan/Legends|Rutan]] and Senali royalty exchange children.

It was later discovered, after the [[Mission to Rutan]], that the Ghost Ones were a work of fiction, created by [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Taroon (Rutanian)|Taroon]] in order to discredit his brother, Prince [[Leed]], so that Taroon himself would gain the throne of Rutan.
